title: Require auth for Copilot Studio
subtitle: Turn on the environment control to block unauthenticated Direct Line access.

steps.title: Open Identity and access
steps.evidence: In Power Platform admin center, Security > Identity and access, Require Microsoft authentication

steps.title: Require Microsoft authentication
steps.evidence: Require Microsoft authentication forces Copilot Studio makers to use Authenticate with Microsoft.

steps.title: Direct Line blocked, SDK still works
steps.evidence: Raw Direct Line clients receive an error before content is shared, while the M365 Agents SDK continues working.
